items.title: Insta360 sets December 1 Ace Pro 3 launch, teasing interchangeable lenses
items.summary: Insta360 will unveil its Ace Pro 3 action camera on December 1 at 8 p.m. Beijing time, the company announced in a teaser released Tuesday evening. The video points to interchangeable lenses, a variable aperture, focusing controls and background blur as the product’s main imaging upgrades.

items.title: Xiaomi targets Germany car launch in third quarter of 2027
items.summary: Xiaomi plans to begin selling cars in Germany in the third quarter of 2027, management said during the company’s quarterly earnings call on Tuesday. The announcement gives a more specific timetable for its European launch, which the company had previously scheduled for the second half of next year.

items.title: Bambu Lab launches $1,149 P3C with seven-slot tool changer
items.summary: Bambu Lab launched its P3C desktop 3D printer worldwide on Tuesday, bringing the tool-changing architecture of its flagship H3C to a $1,149 package. The P3C AMS Combo includes the printer, an AMS 3P filament-management system and five print tools, with two additional slots available for expansion.

items.title: Huawei connects Chinese chip-design tools in real-world project
items.summary: Huawei has linked software from Chinese electronic design automation developers into a working tool chain tested on an actual chip project, according to a presentation at its innovation and intellectual property forum in Beijing on Tuesday.

items.title: BMW launches China-made Neue Klasse iX3 from RMB269,900
items.summary: BMW launched its China-made Neue Klasse iX3 and began deliveries on Wednesday, with three versions priced from RMB269,900 to RMB339,900. The electric SUV has been lengthened for Chinese buyers, with a 3,005mm wheelbase that is 108mm longer than the international version.

items.title: Ant releases Ling-3.2-air multimodal model under MIT license
items.summary: Ant Group released the weights for Ling-3.2-air on Tuesday under the MIT license. The model processes text, images and video, with development focused on agents that use tools and complete professional workflows. Ling-3.2-air uses a hybrid linear-attention mixture-of-experts architecture.

items.title: BYD launches new Tang EV from RMB187,900 with up to 850km range

items.title: Baidu opens ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview weights with million-token context
items.summary: Baidu released the weights for ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview on Tuesday, bringing its recently introduced model to developers who want to deploy it on their own infrastructure. The post-trained checkpoint is available under the Apache 2.0 license and supports a context window of up to one million tokens.

items.title: Huawei launches Mate X8 foldable with Kirin 9050 Pro, starting at RMB12,999
items.summary: Huawei launched its Mate X8 foldable smartphone in China on Tuesday, with prices starting at RMB12,999 for a model with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. The lineup extends to a 16GB/2TB version priced at RMB20,999.
